question: ________ suggests a 20 mm wide margin for sheet sizes A0 and A1 in engineering drawing.
solution:
**Concept**

 
• Engineering drawings follow specific standards to ensure uniformity and readability. In India, the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) provides these guidelines.
 
• The publication **SP 46: 2003** (Engineering Drawing Practice for Schools and Colleges) serves as a comprehensive guide based on various IS (Indian Standard) codes.
 
• Standard **IS 10711**, which is included in SP 46, specifies the sizes and layout of drawing sheets, including margins, borders, and title blocks.
